title: Geometric regularity descends through faithfully flat maps
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $A\to B$ be a faithfully flat map of $k$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. If $B$ is geometrically regular over $k$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], then $A$ is geometrically regular over $k$.

proof.text: Geometric regularity of B includes Noetherianity by def-weil-pbc-g-ring. Descend Noetherianity to A by lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-descent-noetherian, specializing the Mathlib module descent theorem to M = A and identifying B tensor_A A with B by the tensor right-unit equivalence.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NH and Noetherian descent Tag 033E

proof.text: Fix a finite purely inseparable field extension K/k. By Module.Finite.small, shrink K to universe max u w, preserving its algebra structure, finiteness and pure inseparability. Apply geometric regularity of B to this shrink and transport regularity back to K tensor_k B by Algebra.TensorProduct.congr. Commute factors to B tensor_k K. Tensor cancellation identifies this ring with B tensor_A (A tensor_k K), and tensor commutativity identifies it with (A tensor_k K) tensor_A B. The latter is faithfully flat over A tensor_k K by lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-base-change. Apply lem-weil-pbc-regular-ring-faithfully-flat-descent, then commute factors to obtain regularity of K tensor_k A. Together with the first step, this proves geometric regularity of A by def-weil-pbc-g-ring. Shrinking and tensor equivalences only replace rings and fields by isomorphic copies.
